reason: A persistent web notepad for global and session-scoped notes with local storage, search, history, live updates, and agent-accessible note tools.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供支持全局和会话作用域、可搜索并可由智能体读写的常驻记事本。
summaries.en: A persistent DeepSeek Harness Web GUI notepad with global and session scopes, search and history, live updates, and agent-accessible note tools.

capabilities: Provides a persistent global and session-scoped notepad
Reads and writes notepad content under ~/.dsh/notepad/
Exposes HTTP and SSE endpoints for note access and updates
Provides agent tools to read, write, and search notes
Displays and edits notes through a draggable web panel
